newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil - prices correct after Monday knock.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil - prices correct after Monday knock.

text.p: Fuel oil showed a firmer tone on Tuesday, consolidating at higher numbers in a correction phase after the knock down it received on Monday.
The recovery was most noticeable in high sulphur barges where a trade was done at $111 fob ARA against talk late yesterday as low as $107 fob ARA.
High sulphur cargoes were seen steady around $108-109 fob NWE. An early October cargo ex-Scandinavia was still heard available.

Details of the Portuguese tender of 150,000 tonnes filtered into the market. A trader won two plus the two optionals while a major secured a further two. Prices for the cargoes were suggested around fob mean Med +$10-10.25 cif Portugal, but this was unconfirmed.

Low sulphur cracked fuel showed indications of impending firmness. A Turkish buy tender was announced for 45-50,000 tonnes for delivery into Izmir and Izmit during October and some traders thought two cargoes might be bought. A 50,000 tonne short into the Med was also uncovered and a trader was heard looking for material for blending purposes. "Low sulphur should have room to move up, its undervalued against high sulphur," said one trader.-- Matt Jones, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
